items.query: Classify the severity of a production API outage affecting every customer and give one concise reason.
Determine whether an unused annual subscription requested after 14 days is inside a documented 30-day refund window.
Recommend the safest next action when a migration checksum differs from the reviewed artifact immediately before deployment.
Summarize the customer impact of a search-index delay that affects new documents but not existing documents.
Identify the evidence an operator should collect before rolling back a model deployment after a quality regression.
Decide whether a failed workflow with provider spend but no successful outcome should be counted as failure tax.
Explain how a legal hold should affect deletion of run payloads while preserving the audit record required by policy.
State the safe behavior when a side-effect provider times out after possibly committing and no authoritative outcome can be found.
